versions.changelog:
- Added explicit requirement for the AGENTWEB_API_KEY environment variable in metadata.
- Declared AGENTWEB_API_KEY as the primary credential.
- No changes to API usage, endpoints, or skill logic.

- Updated the setup process to require a user-provided API key from https://agentweb.live (no longer auto-registers silently on first use).
- Clarified API key options: users can sign up themselves or provide an email to register via the agent.
- Improved documentation with more explicit sample curl commands for all API endpoints.
- Removed the scripts/register.sh helper script.
- Added a pointer to the full API reference documentation.
- Revised the skill description and metadata for clarity.

Auto-registration and easier setup for the AgentWeb skill.

- No manual API key setup required; skill auto-registers for a free API key on first use.
- Prompts user for email if no API key is found, registers via API, and uses the new key automatically.
- Updated description and documentation to reflect simpler onboarding.
- Metadata added to clarify dependencies (requires curl).
- All existing endpoints and contribute/report workflows unchanged.

- Updated description to clarify requirement for explicit user approval before contributing data.
- Changed environment variable name for the API key to AGENTWEB_API_KEY and updated setup instructions.
- Added guidance to always ask users before submitting business data to AgentWeb.
- Removed agent-initiated automatic data contribution; contributing is now user-approved only.
- Included privacy reminder: never contribute personal or private data, only public business info.

Initial release of AgentWeb global business directory integration.

- Search, retrieve, and view details for 11M+ businesses across 195 countries.
- Contribute new business data or enrich existing entries, helping the directory grow.
- Free API with simple setup—API key registration and clear usage instructions.
- Endpoints include search, get details, contribute, and report business problems.
- Designed for agents and users needing business contact info, hours, or location data.
